item.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist, alleging espionage
item.description: The arrest comes as bilateral relations have sharply deteriorated over the war in Ukraine and the territorial dispute over the Kuril Islands.

item.title: These common infections can cause cancer. Here’s what can lower your risk.
item.description: Recent research indicates that infectious diseases cause around 12 percent of new cancer cases.

item.title: In which Winnie-the-Pooh turns 100 and Britain wants its bear back
item.description: The original bear and his friends are being held at the New York Public Library, against the will of some British fans who say it’s time for them to come home.

item.title: What to know about pulmonary adenocarcinoma
item.description: Pope Leo XIV’s doctors discovered lung cancer, prompting the removal of a portion of his right lung.

item.title: Pope Leo enters hospital for surgery on lung nodule
item.description: Several hundred people gathered at Rome's Gemelli Hospital before the pope's operation, news of which had caught many in Vatican City off guard.

item.title: India’s Modi faces unprecedented challenge to power as youth mobilize
item.description: Until this month’s “cockroach” protests over changes to India’s voter rolls, the prime minister’s political might went all but unchallenged among the nearly billion-strong electorate.

item.title: U.K. intelligence chief warns Iran is shifting plots to ‘harder targets’
item.description: In annual speech on threats, Ken McCallum, the head of MI5, cited a “major shift” in Tehran’s “ambitions” to attack military sites and other high-security targets.

item.title: As Houthis strike Riyadh, Saudi Arabia confronts the costs of U.S. war on Iran
item.description: Deadly attacks by Yemen’s rebels have left Saudi leader Mohammed bin Salman juggling security risks and the kingdom’s economic ambitions.

item.title: U.S. and NATO commander vows to thwart Moscow, warns Kyiv over refinery strikes
item.description: The mixed signals expose a split in President Donald Trump’s approach to Russia, amid strain on energy markets.

item.title: U.K. prime minister accuses Russia of meddling in Brexit vote
item.description: Officials scrambled to clarify that Andy Burnham’s remarks did not mean the government rejected the outcome of the controversial 2016 referendum.
